title: Imp Catcher
start: Talk to Wizard Mizgog on the floor 2 of the Wizards' Tower, south of Draynor Village.

recommended.t: Skull sceptre or Edgeville lodestone to the air altar
Ring of duelling or Al Kharid lodestone to the fire altar
Enlightened amulet or Lumbridge lodestone to the water altar
Fort Forinthry lodestone, Invitation box, or Archaeology journal to the earth altar

rewards.t: Wizard Mizgog will from now on sell you amulets of accuracy for 5000 coins.

steps.t: Talk to Wizard Mizgog on the floor 2 of the Wizards' Tower, just southeast of the beam. [Chat: 1 Can I help you? › Accept]

sub.t: Make a bowl of hot water if you haven't already, by filling a bowl at a water source, then using it on a Cooking range (all available in the Lumbridge Castle kitchen - If you have not done Cook's Assistant, you can use the range in the southeasternmost house in Lumbridge, south of Bob's Axes). You may also light a fire and use a bowl of water on it.

steps.t: Go to the Water ruins (west side of Lumbridge Swamp) and talk to the Phlegmatic imp. [Chat: 3 Have you tried a bowl of hot water?]

sub.t: Talk to the imp again, with a bowl of hot water in your inventory.
Take the Phlegmatic bead it drops.

steps.t: Go to the Fire ruins (north of Al Kharid; outside Het's Oasis), talk to and fight the Choleric imp.

sub.t: Take the Choleric bead it drops.

steps.t: Go to the Earth ruins (north-east of Varrock; south of Fort Forinthry) and cheer up the Melancholic imp. [Chat: 3 Why would he be disappointed? › 2 Some days you'll have setbacks. Tomorrow is new day. › 1 Take your time. No one is rushing you to feel better.]

sub.t: Take the Melancholic bead it drops.

steps.t: Go to the Air ruins (west of Varrock; southeast of Barbarian Village) and talk to the Sanguine imp.

sub.t: Race the imp around the altar 4 times by clicking and running inside the four different checkpoints when they appear.
Take the Sanguine bead it drops.

steps.t: Return and talk to Wizard Mizgog. [Chat: 1 I've got all four beads.]
